mbti.title: MBTI Personality Assessment
mbti.description: Based on your answers, your personality type is {type}.

R.name: Realistic
R.desc: Skilled at working with machines, tools, and systems. You enjoy practical results and hands-on work.

I.name: Investigative
I.desc: Analytical and logical. You enjoy solving complex problems and exploring intellectual curiosities through research.

A.name: Artistic
A.desc: Creative and free-spirited. You like to give shape to original ideas through your artistic sensibilities.

S.name: Social
S.desc: Find meaning in helping, teaching, and counseling others. You value emotional exchange and cooperation.
S.jobs: Teacher, Counselor, Nurse, Social Worker, etc.

E.name: Enterprising
E.desc: Goal-oriented with excellent leadership. You enjoy persuasive and dynamic activities that lead people and organizations.

C.name: Conventional
C.desc: Systematic and precise. Excel at organizing data and completing tasks efficiently according to rules.
C.jobs: Accountant, Administrator, Data Analyst, Banker, etc.

riasec.title: Career Interest Assessment (RIASEC)
riasec.description: Based on our analysis, your primary career interest pattern is {type}.
